verdict.rationale: Only community comments suggest this capability. One says Dagster has "figured out how to do development branches"; a team member describes testability achieved by separating business logic from environmental concerns, with a seamless laptop-to-prod workflow. No first-party docs in the pack describe a sandbox or branch environment isolated from production data, and asset checks are data-quality tests, not environment isolation. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of branch/sandbox deployments, explicit isolation from production data, configuration of separate test resources, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
